title: Checkout DB connection pool exhaustion
symptom_pattern: DB_TIMEOUT with rising p95 latency and pool waiters

remediation.immediate: Rollback the recent checkout deployment if the pool configuration changed; verify DB pool size and active connections; monitor 5xx and p95.

title: Pod OOMKilled / memory leak
symptom_pattern: Memory rises continuously and pods restart with OOMKilled

remediation.immediate: Capture heap evidence, check recent code/config changes, raise capacity only as a temporary mitigation, and roll back if the release introduced the leak.

title: Third-party payment provider outage
symptom_pattern: Upstream payment calls time out and circuit breaker opens

remediation.immediate: Confirm provider health, keep circuit breaker protection enabled, route/retry only where safe, and communicate provider dependency impact.

title: Redis cache stampede
symptom_pattern: Cache hit rate collapses after bulk invalidation and DB traffic rises

remediation.immediate: Restore cache warming/invalidation controls, throttle cache rebuild if needed, and protect the database from a thundering herd.

title: JWT key rotation mismatch
symptom_pattern: Mass 401 responses and signature verification failures after key rotation

remediation.immediate: Verify the active signing key and JWKS propagation, refresh downstream key caches, and validate token verification before reopening traffic.

title: API gateway high latency
symptom_pattern: p95/p99 latency rises without a clear error-rate increase

remediation.immediate: Inspect gateway saturation, upstream latency, throttling and queue depth; compare p50/p95/p99 and dependency health before changing traffic.
